output: html_document
---

# Load Packages
```{r}
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(viridis)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

# Load Data

```{r}
planet_grids = st_read('./data/planet_grids_for_arts_closest_year.geojson')
world = rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")
world = world |>
  st_transform(3413) |>
  st_crop(planet_grids |>
            st_bbox() |>
            st_as_sfc() |>
            st_buffer(dist = 200000) |>
            st_bbox())
```

# Data Stats

```{r}
print(
  paste('The total number of images downloaded is', 
        nrow(planet_grids))
  )
```

```{r}
planet_grids_count = planet_grids |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            .by = c(geometry))
```

# Map of Downloads

```{r, fig.height=7.5, fig.width=6.5}
ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(
    data = world,
    color = 'transparent',
    # fill = '#EEFFDD',
    fill = 'white'
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = planet_grids_count,
    aes(color = n,
        fill = n),
    linewidth = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  # scale_color_viridis(name = 'N Years',
  #                     direction = -1) +
  # scale_fill_viridis(name = 'N Years',
  #                     direction = -1) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    name = 'Image\nCount',
    low = 'gray60',
    high = 'black'
    # low = '#6699FF',
    # high = '#000033'
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    name = 'Image\nCount',
    low = 'gray60',
    high = 'black'
    # low = '#6699FF',
    # high = '#000033'
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = world,
          color = 'gray20',
          fill = 'transparent') +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(
      # fill = '#DDEEFF'
      fill = 'gray90'
      ),
    panel.grid = element_line(
      # color = 'gray90
      color = 'gray80'
      ),
    legend.position = 'inside',
    legend.position.inside = c(0.998, 0.002),
    legend.justification = c(1, 0)
  )

# ggsave('./figures/planet_basemap_downloads.jpg')
```
